article.title: Drupal Warns of New Highly Critical Site Takeover Vulnerability Under Active Exploitation
article.summary: Drupal has warned of a new "highly critical" security flaw impacting Drupal core that it said has been exploited in the wild. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-136716 (CVSS score: N/A), has been described as a case of improper checking for unusual or exceptional conditions. article.title: Critical Juniper Session Smart Conductor Flaw Exploited in Attacks
article.summary: Tracked as CVE-2026-103406, the vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root. The post Critical Juniper Session Smart Conductor Flaw Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.relevance_reason: Lỗ hổng nghiêm trọng trên Juniper Session Smart Conductor đang bị kẻ tấn công khai thác để thực thi lệnh tùy ý với quyền root.

article.title: Mitel MiCollab Zero-Days Exploited in Suspected AI-Assisted Attacks
article.summary: Accenture says hackers exploited MiCollab flaws before Mitel’s advisory, likely aided by AI, in a suspected extortion campaign. The post Mitel MiCollab Zero-Days Exploited in Suspected AI-Assisted Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.relevance_reason: Hacker khai thác các lỗ hổng zero-day trong Mitel MiCollab nhằm mục đích tống tiền với sự hỗ trợ của trí tuệ nhân tạo.
